  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  MARCH 10, 2026

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Torosis at 5:35 p.m., on
  Tuesday, March 10, 2026, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Caroline Torosis
  Mayor Pro Tern Jesse Zwick (arrived at 6:42 p.m.)
  Councilmember Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  Interim City Attorney Heidi von Tongeln
  Assistant City Clerk Maria Dacanay-Wisner

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:35 p.m. to hear the
  5:30 p.m. regular meeting and the 5:35 p.m. concurrently, with all members
  present except Mayor Pro Tern Zwick. Councilmember Zernitskaya led the
  assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
  ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember Raskin.
  (LAND
  ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)

  LEVINE ACT  No Councilmembers made disclosures regarding the Levine Act (Govt Code
  DISCLOSURE  Section 84308).

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  No members of the public commented on Closed Session items for the
  CLOSED SESSION ONLY: special meeting.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 6:40 p.m., to consider
  (Mayor Pro Tern Zwick  Closed Sessions and returned at 8:24 p.m., with all members present, to
  arrived at 6:42 p.m.)  report the following:

  5.A. Conference with legal counsel - potential initiation of litigation -
  Gov. Code§ 54956.9(d)(4)-1 case

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard and direction was given by
  a vote of 7 to O to initiate litigation.

  1  March 10, 2026
 Docusign Envelope ID: D1BDF40A-5FA1-46A1-9C70-CCBF08BBE502

  5.B. Conference with real estate negotiator - Gov. Code § 54956.8;
  property: 2640 Main Street, Santa Monica, California; City negotiator:
  Oliver Chi, City Manager; owner of record: City of Santa Monica;
  persons to be negotiated with Adir Tai and Garner Gelson, The
  Santamonican Club, LLC, a California corporation d.b.a.
  Santamonican; under negotiation: price and terms of payment for lease

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

  5.C. Public employee appointment - Gov. Code§ 54957(b): consider
  public employee appointment; title: City Attorney; Gov. Code §
  54957.6: conference with labor negotiator; City negotiator: Mayor/City
  Manager; unrepresented employee: City Attorney

  The Mayor advised this matter was heard and Interim City Attorney Heidi
  von Tongeln accepted the Council's offer. The City Attorney's contract will
  be agendized for the March 24, 2026 Council meeting with an effective date
  of March 25.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council special meeting adjourned at 8:27
  p.m.
